tickets.title: Room search: filter by feature
tickets.body: Students asked for rooms with a projector. GET /api/rooms?feature=projector now returns only the rooms that have one. Shipped in 1.3.0.

tickets.title: Back-to-back bookings rejected as a conflict
tickets.body: A booking that started exactly when another one ended came back as 409 conflict. Bookings are half-open ranges now, so 10:00-11:00 and 11:00-12:00 can both exist. Fixed in 1.3.0.

tickets.title: Events page: mark cancelled events
tickets.body: Cancelled events vanished from /events without a word, and people still turned up. They now stay listed, struck through and marked Cancelled.

tickets.title: Nightly digest: one digest per building
tickets.body: Facilities want one digest per building, mailed to that building's porters, instead of one long digest for the whole campus.

tickets.title: Room page: show accessibility details
tickets.body: Step-free access is a yes or no today. Show the nearest lift and accessible toilet on the room page; Facilities will send the data as a CSV file.

tickets.title: Rate-limit booking creation per API key
tickets.body: One misbehaving script created 400 bookings in a minute last term. Limit POST /api/bookings to 30 a minute per API key and answer 429 after that.

tickets.title: Digest mail goes out twice when the job is re-run
tickets.body: When the scheduler retries the job after a timeout, the digest mail goes out twice. Blocked on the mail relay team: their API has no idempotency key yet.

tickets.title: Release 1.4.0
tickets.body: Scope: CH-104 and CH-105. Follow the release checklist in README.md (Releasing): bump the version, update CHANGELOG.md, run the tests, dry-run the deploy, and ask the release approver to deploy.

tickets.title: Rotate the staging API key
tickets.body: The staging API key is 90 days old. Rotate it in the campus secret store and restart the staging API. Keys never go into a ticket, a commit or a chat.

tickets.title: Bookings API: reject bookings longer than 4 hours
tickets.body: Long bookings blocked rooms for whole afternoons. POST /api/bookings now rejects anything over 4 hours with a 400 that names the end field.

tickets.title: Room names with an ampersand break the rooms page
tickets.body: A room called "Tom & Jerry's room" broke the table on the rooms page. Pages now build their HTML with the html helper, which escapes every value.

tickets.title: Flaky test: the server test used a fixed port
tickets.body: server.test.mjs listened on port 3080 and failed while a dev server was running. It now listens on port 0 and reads the port back.
